# Mosquito Ninja

Mosquito Ninja is an owner-operated mosquito and tick control service for South Jersey residential, commercial, municipal and government-managed outdoor properties.

Primary contact: 609-313-6317
Website: https://njbugninja.com/

## Services

Mosquito control focuses on outdoor resting and harborage areas relevant to the property, such as dense foliage, shaded edges and damp areas.

Tick control focuses on habitat such as wooded edges, leaf litter, low brush, stone walls and transition zones used by people and pets.

Commercial and government service is available for outdoor business, hospitality, municipal and government-managed properties, subject to route and scheduling availability.

## Service area

The current focus is South Jersey. Property-specific route coverage and scheduling should be confirmed directly with Mosquito Ninja.

## Important service information

Mosquito Ninja does not promise complete elimination of mosquitoes or ticks. Outdoor pest pressure varies with weather, habitat and neighboring properties. Customers receive product-specific re-entry instructions for their visit.
